The owners are available, attentive and very responsive, which is invaluable in daily life. They understand the challenges of independent practice, particularly for psychologists, which is felt in the way they support tenants. I recommend these spaces without hesitation, especially for a first independent practice setup.

approach.heroTitle: Spaces designed for care, built to last
approach.heroP1: I‑CA.RE was born from a simple conviction: care and wellbeing professions deserve spaces genuinely adapted to their human, relational and professional demands.
approach.heroP2: Confidentiality, acoustic quality, comfort, professional image, patient welcome: these dimensions cannot be improvised. They must be considered from the very design of the space.
approach.heroP3: We transform urban ground floors into workspaces suited to contemporary therapeutic practices, reconciling architectural rigour with a deep understanding of usage.
approach.foundersTitle: A vision driven by two complementary expertises
approach.foundersIntro: I‑CA.RE is an independent, family-backed property company. It draws on the convergence of care expertise and proven real estate and technical mastery.
approach.jazminP1: A brief-therapy practitioner based in Bordeaux, Jazmin supports children from age 6, adolescents and adults dealing with post-traumatic stress, depression, anxiety and burnout. She helps overcome trauma, emotional distress and relationship difficulties, whether family, friendship, romantic or professional.
approach.jazminP2: Her approach is integrative and humanistic. She pays particular attention to the quality of the therapeutic relationship, emotional safety and the setting in which care takes place.
approach.jazminP3: Her daily experience of clinical practice directly shapes the design of I‑CA.RE spaces: a calming atmosphere, respect for confidentiality, acoustic quality, and a balance between intimacy and openness.
approach.nicolasP1: A real-estate entrepreneur, Nicolas founded IDN Capital in 2019, a Bordeaux-based investment firm that structures, transforms and develops complex real-estate assets (office, healthcare, shared residential) across Nouvelle-Aquitaine.
approach.nicolasP2: IDN Capital relies on an ecosystem of independent companies covering the full value chain: complex real-estate engineering and refurbishment with Rivage, strategic advisory with IDNéa, interior construction with INside BAT, shared housing with co-liv.ing.
approach.nicolasP3: I‑CA.RE is the health and wellbeing branch of this ecosystem: it transforms urban ground floors into spaces dedicated to care, paramedical practice and wellbeing.
approach.nicolasP4: Nicolas oversees the structuring of operations, architectural quality, regulatory compliance and the long-term durability of assets.
approach.synthesisP1: Every I‑CA.RE space is designed at the intersection of two realities:
approach.synthesisBullet2: The technical and urban constraints of real estate
approach.synthesisP2: We develop our assets progressively and with control, paying particular attention to local roots and quality of use.
approach.synthesisP3: Our ambition is not rapid growth, but the lasting creation of professional spaces suited to care and wellbeing professions.
approach.ctaTitle: Want to contribute to this vision?
approach.ctaDesc: Whether you are a care or wellbeing practitioner, a local authority or an investor, join us in this mission.

locationBordeaux.h1: Consultation offices for rent in Bordeaux for care & wellbeing practitioners
locationBordeaux.heroSubtitle: Renovated, acoustically insulated, turnkey consultation rooms across Bordeaux. In Chartrons, room 5 is available full time and room 1 is shared part time (Monday, Thursday, Friday and Saturday free): visit the centre and its neighbourhood.
locationBordeaux.heroImageAlt: I‑CA.RE consultation office for rent in Bordeaux
locationBordeaux.introTitle: Finding an office in Bordeaux: a real challenge for practitioners
locationBordeaux.introP1: Psychologists, osteopaths, therapists, nurses… finding a consultation office for rent in Bordeaux that combines confidentiality, accessibility and controlled rent remains a real struggle. Available premises are rarely suited to care practice: poor acoustic insulation, no disability access, inadequate surfaces.
locationBordeaux.introP2: That is why I‑CA.RE identifies undervalued ground-floor spaces across Bordeaux neighbourhoods and transforms them into next-generation consultation rooms. Every space is designed for the therapeutic relationship: enhanced soundproofing, natural light, full ERP and disability compliance, warm welcome areas.
locationBordeaux.introP3: With I‑CA.RE, renting an office in Bordeaux becomes simple: a turnkey space, transparent rent, and a community of committed practitioners.
locationBordeaux.centresSubtitle: Four locations open and three in preparation across the Bordeaux metropolitan area, each with its own character and neighbourhood.

why.spacesDesc: Enhanced acoustic insulation, natural light, ERP and disability compliance: every consultation room is designed to foster confidentiality and patient comfort.
why.neighbourhoodsDesc: Our offices are on the ground floor, in vibrant neighbourhoods across the Bordeaux metropolitan area: in Bordeaux (Chartrons, Nansouty, Pey-Berland, Jardin Public), with new locations in preparation in Lormont and Le Bouscat, close to transport and residents.

locationBordeaux.faqTitle: Frequently asked questions about office rental in Bordeaux

faq.q1: How to find an office for rent in Bordeaux?
faq.a1: I‑CA.RE offers turnkey consultation offices in several Bordeaux neighbourhoods. You can browse available spaces on the Our Care Spaces page or contact us directly to discuss your setup project.
faq.q2: What surface area for a consultation office?
faq.a2: Our offices range from 11 to 15 sqm, an optimised surface for individual practice (psychology, osteopathy, sophrology, etc.). Each space can be personalised to your needs.
faq.q3: Can you share an office in Bordeaux?
faq.a3: Yes, office sharing is possible and encouraged. Several practitioners can share time slots in the same office, reducing costs while benefiting from a high-quality professional space.
faq.q4: How much does it cost to rent a healthcare office in Bordeaux?
faq.a4: In Chartrons, room 5 (13.1 sqm) is offered at €790/month, rent excluding charges, not subject to VAT; room 1 (11.1 sqm) is shared part time, at €190, €340 or €460/month charges included for one, two or three fixed days per week. Rents at other centres depend on the room and rental option. Nicolas provides detailed terms within 24 hours.

locationBordeaux.ctaDesc: Looking for a therapy office or healthcare office for rent in Bordeaux? Contact us to discuss your project.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before joining an I‑CA.RE space.
faq.a1: Each I-CA.RE location comprises 7 to 10 private offices of 11 to 15 sqm, plus shared common areas: waiting room, restrooms and a break area. Offices are fully partitioned and soundproofed to ensure the confidentiality of exchanges.
faq.a2: For the full-time professional lease, the rent excluding charges covers exclusive use of your office and access to common areas; the service charge provisions, detailed in the lease, cover maintenance of shared spaces, building insurance and running costs (water, communal electricity, internet). There are no hidden fees beyond the rent and these provisions.
faq.a2DayOfficeLink: For the day office offer, see the dedicated page.
faq.a3: Yes, each office is delivered turnkey: flooring, paint, lighting, electrical outlets and network are in place. You can start practising from day one. For the full-time professional lease, furniture (desk, chair, décor) is your responsibility to personalise your space; the day office is also let unfurnished.
faq.a4: We offer flexible professional leases, generally 3 years renewable, with 6 months' notice. This can be adapted to your situation. Our goal is to offer stability while remaining flexible.
faq.a5: We ensure a coherent and respectful community. Practitioners are selected based on their professional practice, compatibility with other occupants and commitment to shared living rules. We favour care, allied health and wellbeing professions.
faq.q6: Are the spaces suitable for receiving the public?
faq.a6: Yes, all our locations comply with disability access standards and regulatory requirements for establishments receiving the public. Patient welcome is considered from the design stage: signage, comfortable waiting room, ground-level access or lift.
faq.a7: Yes, if you need several spaces (for example for a practice requiring two rooms or to host a colleague), we can adapt the configuration. Contact us to discuss.
faq.q8: In which cities are you located?
faq.a8: We are currently based in Bordeaux, with several operating assets and others in development across the Bordeaux metropolitan area. Our ambition is to expand progressively to other French cities.
faq.ctaDesc: Our team is available to answer all your questions and support you in your installation project.
